title_en: Technology and Engineering (19/20): A Class at a Coding Boot Camp
note_en: Verb + 着 marks an action in progress or a continuing state, giving a scene its background: 老师在白板上讲解着今天的内容，学生们认真地做着笔记 "the teacher was going over today's material on the whiteboard while the students took careful notes." English uses "-ing" forms for this; Chinese has no tense, so 着 sets the scene, while 了 in the next sentences moves the story forward.
